heritage.title: Chartering of the JPAMA Sihaya Chapter
heritage.summary: Official accreditation and solemn chartering under the USLT School of Accountancy, Business, and Hospitality, inaugurating the 'Sihaya' batch.

publicationContent.headline: The Dawn of Sihaya: Chartering of JPAMA USLT Chapter
publicationContent.author: Executive Secretariat & Editorial Board
publicationContent.pullQuote: From earnest discussions in SABH lecture halls arose a resolute conviction: Louisian Management Accountants must possess a sacred forum of their own.
publicationContent.fullArticleHtml:
In the academic year 2023, the Bachelor of Science in Management Accounting fraternity witnessed a defining milestone in collegiate leadership. Under the guidance of faculty advisers and with the blessing of the SABH administration, the Junior Philippine Association of Management Accountants (JPAMA) – University of Saint Louis Tuguegarao Chapter was solemnly chartered.

Christened as Sihaya—a classical vernacular term evoking the first rays of radiant morning dawn—the chapter committed itself to elevating technical mastery in cost management, strategic decision-making, and financial governance.

During the inaugural convocation held at Bulwagang San Jacinto, founding officers took their solemn oath to defend academic integrity, foster multi-sectoral camaraderie, and champion professional competence across Cagayan Valley.

heritage.title: Inaugural BSMA Academic Summit & CMA Forum
heritage.summary: Hosted the northern regional assembly on strategic cost management, digital analytics, and CMA certification pathways.

publicationContent.headline: Forging Strategic Visionaries: The 2024 BSMA Summit
publicationContent.author: Committee on Academic & Professional Development
publicationContent.pullQuote: The contemporary management accountant is no longer a mere keeper of ledgers, but the visionary navigator of organizational strategy.
publicationContent.fullArticleHtml:
Gathering over two hundred aspiring accountants, the 2024 Academic Summit convened industry practitioners and CMA luminaries to deliberate on the transformative shifts across modern corporate finance.

Keynotes explored algorithmic cost tracking, ethical sustainability reporting, and the rigorous journey toward international certification. The summit catalyzed university-wide enthusiasm, setting a benchmark for future student academic symposia across Saint Louis.

heritage.title: Expansion of Digital Resource Vault & Reviewer Repository
heritage.summary: Launched the central repository providing comprehensive testbanks, reviewer modules, and lecture notes for all 4 BSMA year levels.

publicationContent.headline: Democratizing Academic Excellence: The JPAMA Resource Vault
publicationContent.author: Directorate of Academic Services
publicationContent.pullQuote: Excellence flourishes when knowledge is generously shared among peers united by a common calling.
publicationContent.fullArticleHtml:
Recognizing the academic demands of qualifying examinations and foundational courses in strategic cost analysis, the JPAMA Executive Board initiated the cloud-integrated Resource Vault.

Curated by top-performing academic scholars and reviewed by faculty advisers, this portal provides 1st through 4th-year Louisian students with direct access to comprehensive mock board exams and study modules.

heritage.title: Sihaya Modernization & Cloud Integration
heritage.summary: Unveiling the official web portal, real-time membership verification, live attendance RSVP, and public institutional gazette.

publicationContent.headline: A New Chapter in Governance: The Unified JPAMA Portal
publicationContent.author: Information & Technology Secretariat
publicationContent.pullQuote: Bridging organizational heritage with cutting-edge technology to serve every Louisian management accountant seamlessly.
publicationContent.fullArticleHtml:
Marking a new era of transparent digital administration, the JPAMA Portal centralizes member verification, event registration, and dynamic constitution access in a unified, mobile-first ecosystem.

Every member now possesses verified credentials, real-time tracking of chapter standing, and instant access to official executive records and constitutional articles.

bylaws.title: NAME AND LOGO
bylaws.summary: Establishes the official chapter designation and heraldic usage of the JPAMA corporate emblem.

sections.title: Official Designation
sections.content: This Organization shall be known as the USLT Local Chapter of JUNIOR PHILIPPINE ASSOCIATION OF MANAGEMENT ACCOUNTANTS herein referred as JPAMA.

sections.title: Official Logo Usage
sections.content: The JPAMA Logo shall be used in every business transaction entered into by this organization.

bylaws.title: GENERAL PROVISIONS AND DEFINITION OF TERMS
bylaws.summary: Outlines foundational identity, governance standards, organizational jurisdiction, and formal definitions.

sections.title: Local Nature & Institution
sections.content: JPAMA is the local organization of students in Bachelor of Science in Management Accounting in the University of Saint Louis Tuguegarao.

sections.title: Character of the Organization
sections.content: JPAMA is a democratic, non-partisan, non-political, and non-profit student organization.

sections.title: Professional Counterpart & Affiliation
sections.content: JPAMA is the only legitimate student-counterpart of PAMA and official university organization of Institute of Management Accountants - USL Student Chapter.

sections.title: Definition of Organization
sections.content: Organization shall mean JPAMA.

sections.title: Federation Year
sections.content: Federation year shall mean one school year and shall end after the Final Examination of the second semester of each Fiscal Year.

sections.title: Assembly
sections.content: The assembly of the Organization shall mean the meetings of the JPAMA leaders and/or members.

sections.title: Leaders
sections.content: Leaders shall mean the elected and appointed leaders of the Organization.

sections.title: JPAMAn
sections.content: JPAMAn means member of the Organization.

sections.title: Majority
sections.content: Majority shall mean more than 50% of the present members in the assembly.

sections.title: Quorum
sections.content: Quorum shall mean 2/3 of the Leaders.

sections.title: Major Activity
sections.content: A major activity of the Organization means:
subpoints: a. An activity that is in line with and pursuant to the objectives of the University of Saint Louis Tuguegarao as communicated by the leaders, noted by the advisers and the dean, recommended by the Dean of Student Affairs and Services, and approved by the Vice President for Administration and/or the University President.
b. An activity that must require the participation of the JPAMAns.

sections.title: Amendments Process
sections.content: Any alterations of the provisions of this Constitution and By-Laws shall mean amending the contents of the Constitution and By-Laws thus, shall undergo the process of Amendments.

bylaws.title: PURPOSES
bylaws.summary: Sets forth the five-fold academic, professional, ethical, and fraternal objectives of the association.

sections.title: Foundational Purposes
sections.content: The purposes of the Organization shall:
subpoints: a) To promote management accounting as a profession and discipline.
b) To familiarize the members with the practical environment and activities specific to the field of management accounting.
c) To uphold moral standards that are in the best interests of the JPAMA, management accounting profession, and its members.

d) To build a relationship of harmony and concord between JPAMA members, other students, and a multisectoral organization for the advancement of a world class nationalist oriented student organization.
e) To foster camaraderie, fellowship and networking among members.

bylaws.title: MEMBERSHIP
bylaws.summary: Defines eligibility, mandatory BSMA standing, annual dues, member rights, duties, and sanctionable violations.

sections.title: Local Membership Qualification
sections.content: Local membership into the Organization is mandatory to all Bachelor of Science in Management Accounting students of the University of Saint Louis Tuguegarao which is duly recognized by the Commission on Higher Education (CHED). However, in case a non-member avails of at least one of the student services offered by the Organization, the said freshman is automatically a member and thus shall abide by this constitution and by-laws.

sections.title: Freshmen Encouragement
sections.content: The freshmen are not mandated but are highly encouraged to be a member of the JPIA Regional Chapter and JPIA National Chapter.

sections.title: Upperclassmen Automatic Federation Membership
sections.content: The students taking up Bachelor of Science in Management Accounting (2nd Year to 4th Year) are automatically members of the JPIA Regional Chapter and JPIA National Chapter.

sections.title: Membership Dues
sections.content: All members must pay a membership fee every year as set by the leaders with due approval by the advisers as follows:
subpoints: a) Local Membership fee (as set by the college student Handbook)
b) Regional Membership fee (as set by the Regional Council)
c) National Membership fee (as set by the National Council)

sections.title: Annual Subsidy
sections.content: All local members must pay a subsidy every year as set by the leaders with due approval by the advisers.

sections.title: Additional Requisite Fees
sections.content: All members may also be required to pay additional fees duly determined and approved by the local chapter leaders and advisers as they see reasonable and just for the benefit of the Organization.

sections.title: Duration & Renewal
sections.content: Membership in the Organization is for a period of one year and is renewable annually.

sections.title: Rights and Suffrage
sections.content: The members of the Organization shall individually or collectively have the right to be informed of any project and/or activity of the Organization and shall have the responsibility to participate in such undertaking and are entitled to vote, be voted for and hold a position.

sections.title: Expressed Duties & Obligations
sections.content: The members of this Organization shall have the following expressed duties and obligations:
subpoints: a) The duty to comply with the provisions of this Constitution and By-Laws and other rules that may be promulgated by the leaders or may be agreed upon by the Organization.
b) The duty to attend assemblies whether general or special;
c) The duty to pay the membership fee and such other fees that may be deemed appropriate by the Leaders in accordance with the Constitution;
d) The duty to comply with any other discretionary requirements of the organization as deemed appropriate by the Leaders.
e) The duty to defend the honor, prestige, and integrity of the organization.
f) The duty to respect the other members of the organization.
g) The duty to support all the undertakings of the organization and participate actively in all the activities and functions of the organization.
h) The duty to deepen their understanding of the concept of the organization.
i) The duty to engender academic excellence in the organization.

sections.title: Violations of Members
sections.content: Violations of members:
subpoints: a) Culpable violations of any provisions of the Constitution and By-Laws.
b) Gross misconduct, dishonesty, discourtesy and disloyalty to the organization.
c) Inefficiency and incompetence in the performance of official duties.

bylaws.title: PROCEEDINGS, SANCTIONS, AND TERMINATION
bylaws.summary: Guarantees due process, details mandatory attendance sanctions, and establishes grounds for membership termination.

sections.title: Due Process Guarantee
sections.content: Proceedings. No member shall be subject to remedies and sanctions without just cause and due process.

sections.title: Remedies and Sanctions
sections.content: Violations of the following duties by a member shall be sanctioned:
subpoints: a) Failure in compliance in the following will subject a member to violations and be sanctioned (per attendance):
i. To attend General Assembly
ii. To participate in the KKP
iii. To attend in the departmental day & night
iv. To attend related activities where participation is required
b) Other such remedies and sanctions deemed appropriate by the Leaders and advisers in accordance with this Constitution and as approved by the office of student affairs and services.

sections.title: Cancellation of Rights & Privileges
sections.content: Students found to be guilty of gross misconduct, dishonesty, disloyalty to the Organization and other cases considered to be grave in nature shall cancel all the rights, interests, and privileges of the member in the services or resources of the Association.

sections.title: Termination of Membership
sections.content: Termination of membership:
subpoints: a) Graduation – any member who is duly recommended by the school's Office of the Registrar for graduation ceases to become a member.
b) Shifters – any member who is disqualified to become a student under Article 2, Section 1 of this Constitution and By-Laws ceases to become a member.

c) Others – any member who, in one way or another, has failed to uphold the purposes, for which this Organization was established, upon the discretion of the JPAMA leaders and Adviser, ceases to become a member.

bylaws.title: THE ASSEMBLY
bylaws.summary: Governs mandatory annual convocations, written notifications, and validity of assembly proceedings.

sections.title: Annual Assembly Schedule
sections.content: There shall be an assembly at least once in a year; the time and date of which shall be scheduled by the leaders.

sections.title: Notice of Assembly
sections.content: At least two weeks prior to the date of the meeting, the Secretary of the Association shall give a written notice of the assembly through mail or use another suitable method to notify all members in writing of the assembly. Any irregularity or failure to provide proper notice will invalidate the procedure.

bylaws.title: LEADERS
bylaws.summary: Prescribes executive portfolios, official duties, assembly cadence, notice guidelines, and governance authorities.

sections.title: Enumeration and Qualifications
sections.content: The duly elected leaders of the organization shall have the power and duties provided under these By-laws or those which may be assigned by the Advisers in conformity thereto.

sections.title: President
sections.content: The President shall be the Chief Executive Officer of the Organization and shall exercise general supervision over the other officers. He shall see to it that the provisions of the Constitution and the By-laws as well as the resolutions approved by the Advisers are complied with. He shall preside at all meetings of the organization; unless otherwise specifically agreed upon. He shall represent the organization in all occasions and in all matters where it should be represented. He shall perform such other duties as are ordinarily appertaining to his office and those that the Advisers may fix or delegate from time to time.

sections.title: Executive Vice President
sections.content: The Executive Vice President shall assist the President in the execution of policies and resolutions adopted by the organization and in matters relating to the regulation of the affairs and activities of the organization. He shall be vested with all the powers and authority required to perform all the duties of the President during the absence or incapacity of the President for any cause. He shall also perform such other duties as may be assigned to him from time to time by the President and/or the Advisers. He shall be the next President right after the current federation year.

sections.title: VP for Academics
sections.content: The Vice-President for Academics shall have the authorities and duties, which include the following aside from those assigned by the Leaders:
subpoints: a) To supervise the implementation of academic projects and activities of the organization;
b) Empower the members to observe the virtue of academic excellence;
c) Take responsibility for Academic Affairs inside and outside the organization;
d) To perform other duties inherent to the position.

sections.title: VP for Non-Academics
sections.content: The Vice-President for Non-Academics shall have the authorities and duties, which include the following aside from those, assigned by the leaders:
subpoints: a) To supervise and execute the complementary role curricular and extracurricular by integrating and coordinating cultural activities and incorporating these in the general activities of the organization;

b) To supervise and execute the complementary role curricular and extracurricular by integrating and coordinating sports activities and incorporate these in the general activities of the organization;
c) To coordinate with other institutions, agencies or organizations necessary for the nonacademic programs of the organization; and,
d) To perform other duties inherent to the position.

sections.title: VP for Finance
sections.content: The Vice-President for Finance shall collect all fees, dues or contributions from the members as required under the Bylaws, or as may be authorized by the Advisers. He shall receive any and all collections of the Organization from whatever source, take charge of all funds, properties and accounts of the Organization, render financial or property reports periodically and as may be necessary. He shall prepare for the monthly meeting of the Leaders, a statement of cash flows and other financial reports that may be required.

sections.title: VP for Audit
sections.content: The Vice-President for Audit shall conduct management audits, examine the books of account of the current fiscal year and ascertain compliance with directives and resolutions of the Advisers as covered by appropriate Leader Resolutions or as recorded in the minutes of the meeting as well as by existing laws and regulations affecting the Organization, among others.

sections.title: VP for Communications
sections.content: The Vice-President for Communications shall have the following authorities and duties, which include the following aside from those assigned by the Leaders:
subpoints: a) To disseminate information within the Organization;
b) To keep minutes of all the assemblies of the Leaders;
c) To disseminate all notices required to be given by this Constitution and By-Laws;
d) To be the custodian of all records, documents and papers of the Organization and to certify all records of the Organization noted by the President; and,
e) To perform other duties inherent to the position.

sections.title: VP for Logistics
sections.content: The Vice-President for Logistics shall have the authorities and duties which include the following aside from those assigned by the Leaders:
subpoints: a) To be responsible for arranging programs and making the materials used for the activities carried out by the Organization; and,
b) To perform other duties inherent to the position.

sections.title: VP for Graphics and Publication
sections.content: The Vice-President for Graphics and Publication shall have the authorities and duties which include the following aside from those assigned by the Leaders:
subpoints: a) To be responsible for information dissemination through the use of social media and advanced technology, photo and video documentation during the activities carried out by the organization.
b) To perform other duties inherent to the position.

sections.title: VP for Marketing and Business Affairs
sections.content: The Vice-President for Marketing shall have the authorities and duties which include the following aside from those assigned by the Leaders:
subpoints: a) To be responsible for the canvassing and purchasing of goods and services needed by the organization or as approved by the Leaders.
b) To carry out business activities of the organization.
c) To perform duties inherent to the position.

sections.title: VP for Membership
sections.content: The Vice-President for Membership shall have the authorities and duties which include the following aside from those assigned by the Leaders:
subpoints: a) To keep a complete and up-to-date list of names of members;
b) To monitor the attendance, performance and degree of participation of members in the Organization assembly and functions; and,
c) To perform other duties inherent to the position.

sections.title: VP for Religious Affairs
sections.content: The Vice-President for Religious Affairs shall have the authorities and duties which include the following aside from those assigned by the Leaders:
subpoints: a) To attend and communicate in all the religious activities and other church-related activities inside and outside the organization.
b) To implement and impose all the rules and regulations of the school regarding Christian living.

sections.title: University Ambassadors
sections.content: The University Ambassadors which includes a student from first, second, third, and fourth year levels, shall have the authorities and duties which include the following aside from those assigned by the Leaders:
subpoints: a) To be the representative of the organization to the University-related activities;
b) To be the representative of students under management accounting course;
c) To inform the class representatives of all year levels on the matters that they should be informed of discussed during assemblies of the leaders;
d) To be the primary implementers of Article V of this Constitution and By-Laws; and,
e) To perform other duties inherent to the position.

sections.title: Secretary
sections.content: The Secretary, who is a bona fide member of the JPAMA shall keep the minutes of all meetings of the members of the Organization. He shall give or cause to be given, all notices required by the Bylaws, as well as notices of all meetings of the Leaders and of the members of the Organization. He shall be the custodian of the corporate seal and shall affix the same attested by his signature to such instruments as may require such seal. He shall make and submit such reports as may be required of him by the Adviser and/or the President and perform such other duties as may be assigned to him from time to time by the Advisers or Leaders.

sections.title: Term of Office
sections.content: The Leaders shall hold office for one Organization year or until their successors have been duly elected.

sections.title: Regular Assembly
sections.content: The Leaders shall hold regular assemblies at least twice a month on such time, place and date as may be agreed upon.

sections.title: Special Assembly
sections.content: Special assembly of the Leaders shall be called at any time by the President or by a written request of the majority of the Leaders and shall be held at such a place, time as may agree upon.

sections.title: Notice of the Assembly
sections.content: Whenever a regular or special assembly is to be held, the President shall direct the Vice President for Communication to notify the members of the Leaders. A notice of special assembly shall state the time and place thereof and the purpose/s for which it is called.

sections.title: Quorum
sections.content: Whenever there is no quorum, no business may be transacted. A majority of quorum shall decide in every question of matters submitted to the Leaders at any such assembly.

sections.title: Duties and Powers
sections.content: It shall be the duty of the Board of Directors to conduct the business and affairs of the Association and to perform such acts as shall foster and promote the purposes of the Association as mentioned in Article II- Purposes.

bylaws.title: VACANCIES AND ELECTION
bylaws.summary: Sets vacancy protocols, nomination criteria, special election triggers, and specific year-level officer eligibility.

sections.title: Vacancies and Delegation of Duties
sections.content: If the office of any of the Executive Officers shall become vacant by death, resignation or otherwise, the remaining directors, if still constituting a quorum, may, by majority vote from the remaining elected officers, choose a successor or successors who shall hold office for the unexpired term, at a special meeting called for the purpose. If there is no longer a quorum, a special election shall be held upon call by any remaining director or at least 10% of members in good standing as of the date of the call, to fill up the vacancies.

sections.title: Election of Officers & Qualifications
sections.content: Candidates for leadership in the Organization must conform to and shall be subject to the following qualifications and requirements:
subpoints: a) He must be a bona fide member of the JPAMA;
b) He must be a qualified member under Article 2, Section 1 of this Constitution and By-Laws;
c) Special qualifications:
i. President open to incoming Third Year and Fourth Year.
ii. VP-Executive open to incoming Third Year students only.
iii. VP-Academics open to incoming Third Year and Fourth Year.
iv. VP-Non-Academics – Sports Coordinator open to incoming Second, Third, and Fourth Year students only.
v. VP-Non-Academics – Socio-cultural Coordinator open to incoming Second, Third, and Fourth Year students only.
vi. VP-Finance open to Third Year students only.
vii. VP-Audit open to incoming Third and Fourth Year students only.
viii. VP-Communications open to incoming Second, Third, and Fourth Year students only.
ix. VP-Logistics open to incoming Second, Third, and Fourth Year students only.
x. VP-Graphics and Publication open to incoming Second, Third, and Fourth Year students only.
xi. VP-Religious Affairs open to incoming Second, Third, and Fourth Year students only.
xii. VP-Marketing and Business Affairs open to incoming Second, Third, and Fourth Year students only.
xiii. VP-Membership open to incoming Second, Third, and Fourth Year students only.
xiv. CECA Coordinator open to incoming Second, Third, and Fourth Year students only.
xv. University Ambassador open to incoming Second, Third, and Fourth Year students only.
xvi. Secretary General open to incoming Second, Third, and Fourth Year students only.
xvii. Year Level Representative open to JPAMA Volunteers.

bylaws.title: FINANCES
bylaws.summary: Establishes the June 1–May 31 fiscal year, annual budget approvals, semi-annual collection, book inspection, and disbursement signatures.

sections.title: Fiscal Year
sections.content: The Fiscal year of the Organization shall be from the first day of June up to the last day of May of each year.

sections.title: Sources of Funds
sections.content: The funds shall emanate from the membership fee and inflows from all other fundraising activities not contrary to public laws, morals and customs. This shall also include the fines and penalties duly approved by the Leader and Advisers.

sections.title: Yearly Budget
sections.content: The Association shall have and maintain an Organization year budget only approved by the JPAMA Adviser contained therein:
subpoints: a) General appropriation fund for non-recurring expenses of the Organization.
b) Specific appropriations for recurring expenses to control disbursement of funds.

sections.title: Collection of Funds
sections.content: The collection of the fund shall be imposed twice every fiscal year during the renewal of membership on or before the end of every semester.

sections.title: Inspection of Accounts
sections.content: The books of account and records of the Association shall be open for inspection by any member in good standing during office hours on any business day.

sections.title: Bank Depository
sections.content: All funds owned and held or otherwise under the custody of the Organization shall be deposited with authorized banks designated by the Leaders.

sections.title: Disbursement and Withdrawals
sections.content: The disbursements and withdrawals shall be allowed through the authorization and signatures of the President and Vice President for Finance. Amount of disbursements, expenditures or withdrawals requires prior approval of all the Leaders.

bylaws.title: AMENDMENTS
bylaws.summary: Sets the affirmative majority vote of executive officers and final JPAMA adviser approval for constitutional amendments.

sections.title: Affirmative Vote of Officers
sections.content: The Constitution and By-Laws may be amended or repealed in whole or in part by the affirmative vote of the majority of the executive officers of the Association present at any regular meeting or in any special meeting duly called for that purpose.

sections.title: Adviser Ratification
sections.content: The amendments shall be subject for final approval by the JPAMA advisers. Any amendment duly approved shall be valid and binding.

bylaws.title: EFFECTIVITY
bylaws.summary: Proclaims formal chapter effectivity beginning Federation Year 2024-2025 and immediate effectivity of adviser-approved amendments.

sections.title: Effectivity Date
sections.content: This Constitution and By-Laws shall take effect starting this Federation Year 2024-2025.

sections.title: Immediate Effectivity of Amendments
sections.content: Amendments of the Constitution and By-Laws shall be effective immediately upon approval by the JPAMA Advisers.

publicationContent.pullQuote: With unwavering fidelity to our BSMA calling, we celebrate scholastic triumphs and institutional breakthroughs that honor Saint Louis.
publicationContent.fullArticleHtml:
The academic year has exemplified unprecedented vigor across our student community. From regional academic podium finishes to the successful rollout of the digital resource library, JPAMA USLT has continuously redefined collegiate leadership.

Through the stewardship of our faculty advisers and the tireless commitment of our executive committees, chapter initiatives registered a 96% student engagement rate across all four year levels.

As we advance into the upcoming semester, our resolve remains steadfast: to cultivate accountants of competence, character, and Christian commitment.
